purpose: Player-name aliases that a HUMAN has reviewed and accepted. Nothing in this file is inferred by code.
rules: An entry may only be added by a person, with provenance naming the evidence they checked.
review_status must be ACCEPTED for an entry to be used. PENDING_REVIEW entries are inert.
canonical_id must be a player id that already exists in the rating registry.
This file never loosens an automated threshold. It is an allowlist, not a matcher.
An accepted alias resolves at confidence 0.95: enough to price a board, and it is the floor a shadow bet requires, so an alias can never be the reason a decision was taken.

aliases.provenance: Kalshi lists 'Mimi Xu' on WTA and ITF boards; the registry holds 'Mingge Xu'. Mimi is widely used as this player's given name in press coverage. NOT VERIFIED against a governing-body record, and the registry also contains eleven other players surnamed Xu, so an automated match here is exactly the merge this project has already had to undo once.
